categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and directly updates CMake feature detection checks and compiler flags.
categories.rationale: Prevents false-positive feature detection in CMake and enables clang-cl compatibility for upcoming native Windows builds. The author notes that `check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags()` can let unsupported flags falsely pass due to ignoring `-Wunknown-argument`, and changing `-msse4` to `-msse4.1` avoids rejection by `clang-cl` while serving as 'a prerequisite for #31507'.
